title: Take the crowded body into saintly company
summary: Meeting the Holy Saint breaks lust and anger in the crowded body. Return the breath before the wound chooses the tone.
takeaway: Return the breath before the wound chooses the tone.
lifeApplication: When the jaw tightens or the chest heats, step back from the screen or doorway and let truth arrive before the self-image does.

source.shortMeaning: Meeting the Holy Saint breaks lust and anger in the crowded body.
source.lifeApplication: When desire and anger crowd the body, go toward saintly company before they choose for you.

evidence.coreClaim: Meeting the Holy Saint breaks lust and anger in the crowded body.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: take the overheated self back from distance until Naam becomes support.
